description: Summon tiering and sub-aura priorities, covering Providence summons, Archangels, and Six Dragons.

providenceSummons.name: Beelzebub
providenceSummons.mainAura: At battle start, sets MC Trance level to 3. Grants MC guaranteed DA, 100% TA, 50% unique ATK, and 20% damage cap.
providenceSummons.subAura: None (strictly main summon or quick summon engine).
providenceSummons.callEffect: Deals 2000% elemental damage (~2.4M-3.0M cap). Inflicts 40% DEF down, 20% debuff res down, dispels 3 buffs, deals 3M plain damage, and inflicts Bore (50% debuff res down, 100,000 supplemental damage).
usageContext: Main summon for all 0-button and 1-turn burst setups
Quick summon in high-difficulty raids for instant 3x dispel and 40% DEF down
providenceSummons.operationalNotes: Cornerstone of modern burst farming. Bore allows instant damage cap saturation.

providenceSummons.name: Belial
providenceSummons.mainAura: Boost to Dark ATK, caps Dark allies max HP at 20,000 (Situational).
providenceSummons.subAura: Grants 30,000 supplemental damage to all allies for all damage instances (normal attacks, echoes, multi-hit skill nukes). Reduces max HP by 30% (calculated before weapon skills).
providenceSummons.callEffect: Random chaotic beneficial or detrimental effect (Cunning Horseplay).
usageContext: Universal sub-slot on 95% of all teams across all elements
providenceSummons.operationalNotes: Drop only in extreme endgame raids (SUBHL/Faa0/NM250) if HP checks are strictly fatal and Ougi-only tactics are required.

providenceSummons.name: Lucifer (Transcendence 250)
providenceSummons.mainAura: 150% boost to all Elemental ATK, 50% boost to max HP. Starting at Lv 230: automatically removes 1 debuff and grants Wings of Pure White (30% normal ATK, 1500/10% revitalize) whenever boss uses special attack.
providenceSummons.subAura: 10% to 30% boost to healing specs for all allies.
providenceSummons.callEffect: Deals massive damage, heals 4000 HP, grants Wings of Pure White (4T), and grants Dispel Cancel (No Limit, 2T) at Lv 250.
usageContext: Main summon or friend summon for multi-turn racing and high-difficulty raids
providenceSummons.operationalNotes: At Lv 250, provides the single best combination of sustain, dispel cancel, and attack amplification in the game.

providenceSummons.name: Bahamut (Transcendence 250)
providenceSummons.mainAura: 150% boost to all Elemental ATK, 50% boost to CA DMG, 20% boost to CA Cap.
providenceSummons.subAura: 30% boost to CA Specs for all allies.
providenceSummons.callEffect: Deals massive damage, grants 80% CA DMG up, 20% CA Cap up, and fills all allies' charge bar by 30-50%.
providenceSummons.operationalNotes: Premier summon for charge attack optimization and instant party bar replenishment.

providenceSummons.name: Yatima
providenceSummons.mainAura: Boost to Water ATK and charge bar gain.
providenceSummons.subAura: Boost to elemental ATK of sub-summons.
providenceSummons.callEffect: 1-turn cut to all allies' skill cooldowns. Simultaneously calls two other equipped sub-summons at random or based on priority.
usageContext: Double summon activation in high-difficulty and burst turns
providenceSummons.operationalNotes: Enables rapid turn-1 multi-summon sequences and cuts cooldowns on long-recast tactical abilities.

providenceSummons.name: Triple Zero
providenceSummons.mainAura: 150% Elemental ATK boost to MC element.
providenceSummons.subAura: Boost to all allies' stats and multiattack.
providenceSummons.callEffect: Phase 1: Massive nuke, grants all allies 100% TA and massive echoes. Phase 2: Deals immense plain damage, dispels, and cancels 24-hit or plain damage omens instantly.
usageContext: Endgame V2 omen solving (Faa0, Hexa, SUBHL)
providenceSummons.operationalNotes: The definitive omen canceler for Battle System 2.0; voids complex raid triggers with a single button press.

archangelSubAuras.callEffect: Dispels 1 buff, delays all foes, fills all allies' charge bar by 20%.
Inflicts Pure Filter (Water DEF down, unable to attack for 1 turn).
All allies gain 30% charge bar, 30% ATK up, and 50% DEF up.
Dispels 1 buff, delays, inflicts Ring of Judgment (foils special attack).
Dispels 1 buff, inflicts Light DEF down, grants Light allies 1-turn ATK cap up.
All allies gain 30% charge bar and 1-turn targeted damage cap up.

sixDragonSubAuras.statBoost: Boost to Fire allies' ATK, DEF, and HP by up to 25%
sixDragonSubAuras.callEffect: Deals massive plain damage nuke and inflicts Red-Hot.

sixDragonSubAuras.statBoost: Boost to Water allies' ATK, DEF, and HP by up to 25%
sixDragonSubAuras.callEffect: Deals massive damage and inflicts Inoculation.

sixDragonSubAuras.statBoost: Boost to Earth allies' ATK, DEF, and HP by up to 25%
sixDragonSubAuras.callEffect: Deals massive damage and inflicts Swallowed.

sixDragonSubAuras.statBoost: Boost to Wind allies' ATK, DEF, and HP by up to 25%
sixDragonSubAuras.callEffect: Deals multi-hit damage and inflicts Green-Breeze.

sixDragonSubAuras.statBoost: Boost to Light allies' ATK, DEF, and HP by up to 25%
sixDragonSubAuras.callEffect: Deals massive damage and restores all allies' HP.

sixDragonSubAuras.statBoost: Boost to Dark allies' ATK, DEF, and HP by up to 25%
sixDragonSubAuras.callEffect: Deals massive damage and inflicts Cursed Death.

generalSlottingRules.rationale: Maximizes flat supplemental damage (Belial 30k) and Seraphic damage cap multipliers (Archangel 15% + Arcarum 10% = 25% total cap increase).
Maintains offensive cap while leveraging Lucifer 250's passive heal specs and automated emergency cleanses on enemy triggers.

recommendedSubSummons: Arcarum HP (The Tower / The Devil / Justice)
generalSlottingRules.rationale: Prioritizes omen resolution tools (Triple Zero, Bubs) and maximum raw HP thresholds over purely offensive supplemental damage.
